title: Repair Hobby runtime contract for frozen market-verification scope
trigger: Production Hobby analysis remained blocked with Runtime data contract failed after browser/CDN cache hardening.
root_cause: The browser runtime validator required the v1 market-verification queue to contain every current EV contribution. Phase 2 intentionally expanded Chelsea from 27 to 33 EV contributions while the v1 verification population remained frozen at 27 contributions / 72 supporting sales.
changes: Added an exact browser validateAnalysisBundle reproduction to CI.
Added market_verification_scope_data to the Hobby analysis-data routes.
Loaded the frozen verification scope into the browser runtime bundle.
Changed market-verification runtime validation from current-EV count equality to exact frozen-scope identity validation.
Retained checks that every frozen queue contribution still exists in current EV with matching EV and market-source provenance.
Versioned runtimeContracts.js as v2 and cache-busted the script URL in index.html.
Added regression checks so the browser runtime contract itself is permanently gated in CI.
observed_failure_before_fix: market verification queue contribution count mismatch
guarantees: The legacy 27-contribution / 72-sale verification population remains frozen.
Phase-2 EV additions do not silently enter the legacy verification sample.
The verification queue must exactly match the card_ids in market-verification-scope-v1.json.
Every frozen queue item must still resolve to a current EV contribution and matching market source.
Browser runtime validation now follows the same frozen-scope semantics as repository validation.
